Cloud

Isolamento del Sistema Operativo Ospite

The practice of isolating virtual machines (guests) from each other and from the host system to prevent unauthorized access and limit the impact of potential breaches in multi-tenant cloud environments.

Quick answer: The practice of isolating virtual machines (guests) from each other and from the host system to prevent unauthorized access and limit the impact of potential breaches in multi-tenant cloud environments.

Questions and answers

What is Isolamento del Sistema Operativo Ospite?

In this glossary, Isolamento del Sistema Operativo Ospite refers to: The practice of isolating virtual machines (guests) from each other and from the host system to prevent unauthorized access and limit the impact of potential breaches in multi-tenant cloud environments.

How is Isolamento del Sistema Operativo Ospite used in cybersecurity?

In cybersecurity communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Configura gli hypervisor per applicare un isolamento rigoroso del sistema operativo ospite per prevenire movimenti laterali e perdite di dati tra macchine virtuali."

Definition

The practice of isolating virtual machines (guests) from each other and from the host system to prevent unauthorized access and limit the impact of potential breaches in multi-tenant cloud environments.

Operational example

Configure hypervisors to enforce strict guest operating isolation to prevent lateral movement and data leakage between virtual machines.

Localized term

Isolamento del Sistema Operativo Ospite

Localized example
